notes: One logical two-leg monthly XAU/XAG chronological block-median reversion package; neither physical leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA reconstructs thirteen synchronized completed month-end log ratios, forms twelve adjacent changes, partitions four chronological blocks of three, sorts only the block means, and fades the even median of the two inner values.

The package targets equal absolute USD notionals, caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one positive RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket recipe. Q09 alone owns realized portfolio correlation.
